subject: Initial payee funding verification & invoice mapping for Coppertrail Inc.
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@coppertrail.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounts@coppertrail.com
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coppertrail banking details + first invoice hook

Hi Nikhil / Priyom,

Thanks for the onboarding call earlier. Per our checklist, attaching the ACH details table we use for first remittance and a completed W-9 (attached). For the test remittance next week we'll send a CSV stub with the remitter id and invoice refs.

Quick summary: 
- Bank: First Harbor Bank (ACH enabled)
- Account name: Coppertrail Inc.
- Routing (ABA): 111000222
- Account: 9876543210
- Remit reference: CT-INV-{PO_NUMBER}

Attachments: Coppertrail_W-9.pdf (attached), will follow CSV for test remittance after micro-deposit clears.

If you need an additional field for PO mapping or invoice tag, let us know — our AR team prefers a single "Remit Reference" tag so we can auto-reconcile.

Thanks,
Samantha Ortiz
Director, Finance Operations
Coppertrail Inc.
attachments: Coppertrail_W-9.pdf (application/pdf, 234 KB)

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@coppertrail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Coppertrail banking details + first invoice hook

Thanks Samantha — received the W-9 and bank details. A couple of quick items before we push to PayOps: 

1) Can you confirm the ACH account type (checking vs. savings)?
2) For the remit reference, does CT-INV-12345 map to your PO field or invoice number? We want to make sure Redwood's PO tag ends up in the same column so auto-recon works.
3) We'll do a micro-deposit today (small amount for verification). Once verified, PayOps will send a test ACH with a CSV stub referencing the invoice.

Marissa — FYI, please prep the vendor record in the portal and add the following PO mapping if Coppertrail confirms: PO -> Remit Reference (CT-INV-). Also include the W-9 scan in the vendor file.

Priyom — I'll need a one-line confirmation for the payment team that we can accept the ABA/account listed and that no additional KYC docs are required beyond W-9.

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: none

From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@coppertrail.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounts@coppertrail.com
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Coppertrail banking details + first invoice hook

Nikhil — quick answers below and attached the CSV stub we used for the test remittance.

- Account type: Checking
- Remit reference: CT-INV-{PO_NUMBER} is preferred. For electronic reconciliation our AR system expects the PO number in that token; invoice number is optional but helpful in the invoice_reference field.
- KYC: W-9 is sufficient for US payments; if you need a bank letter we can provide it but we've not had that requested before.

We're doing the micro-deposit on our end tomorrow morning and will confirm the amounts in this thread. Attached: coppertrail_ach_remit_20270427.csv (sample header: remitter_id,po_number,invoice_number,amount,remit_reference).

Thanks — Samantha
attachments: coppertrail_ach_remit_20270427.csv (text/csv, 4 KB)

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Coppertrail banking details + first invoice hook

Jordan / Marissa — forwarding confirmed banking + CSV stub from Coppertrail. Action items for PayOps and FinOps: 

- Add vendor record: Coppertrail Inc., account/checking ABA 111000222 / acct 9876543210. W-9 attached in thread.
- PO mapping: set PO -> remit_reference token format "CT-INV-{PO_NUMBER}" so incoming remits map to PO field for auto-reconcile.
- Micro-deposit flow: vendor will run micro-deposit tomorrow; once we confirm amounts, enable ACH and process one $0.01 test ACH with CSV stub.
- Please upload po-mapping-instructions.pdf (internal) to the vendor file and confirm when schedule is set for first payable (anticipated week of 05/03).

Quote from vendor below for context:
> Account type: Checking
> Remit reference: CT-INV-{PO_NUMBER} is preferred. For electronic reconciliation our AR system expects the PO number in that token; invoice number is optional.

Jordan — can you confirm the pay-run cadence and that the accounting system will accept the remit_reference token as the PO key? Marissa, once Jordan confirms, set the vendor live in the portal.

Thanks,
Nikhil
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: po-mapping-instructions.pdf (application/pdf, 48 KB)
